5123.Name: Island Notes
5123.LongDescription: In the late hours I awoke to the light treading steps of Lucius. He snuck away from the camp in secrecy, so I followed him, arriving at a concealed cave containing the materials needed to repair the ship. 166002.Name: Historian's Notes - Page 1
166002.Description:
I discovered a remote village on my travels. It's covered in ice and snow, and only a few families still live here. As for the others... they're nowhere to be found.
The people who stayed here all fell into a coma with high fevers and were marked with strange scars. I tried to cure them with the herbal medicine I had with me, but there was no sign of improvement.
I remember reading about this disease in an ancient medical book, but I am old, and my memory fails me.

166003.Name: Historian's Notes - Page 2
166003.Description:
Twisted creatures that prowled the woods, as well as the snow, ice, eerie black mist kept me from further investigation.
"Corruptors" I think that's what the book called those monsters. But the records are vague, and only mention large-scale elemental imbalances.
A resident suffering from a high fever had scars that continued to spread all over his body. Then... He turned into one of those twisted creatures that I had witnessed in the woods right before my very own eyes.
I finally know where all those missing residents went.

166004.Name: Historian's Notes - Page 3
166004.Description:
There's nobody alive in the village, they've all turned into those twisted creatures. I think it's time I departed this place and returned to the Dark Forest.
I must return to find that ancient book, perhaps I can find some clues within it. I have a something like this will happen again.
Snow and ice cover may cover up tracks, but not history. I hid my notes in the corner of my house, hoping sooner or later someone would find out what was going on here.

400306.Name: Lost Scroll
400306.LongDescription: The annual anniversary of the Hypogean War is approaching. In the year of 74, the Goddess Dura sealed the Hypogeans behind The Barred Gate, signaling triumph and the end of the first Hypogean War. During the long war, the people of the Lightbearer Empire rallied together and eventually succeeded in defeating the threat, defending their homeland. It is the crowning glory of every citizen. The land beneath our feet is soaked with the blood and hopes of our ancestors, and the glory of the past should be remembered, while the historic fight against evil should never be forgotten. While making merry, please spare a moment to remember those who sacrificed everything to defend their homes, and remember that the Hypogean threat is never far away. It is our duty to be vigilant against any evil, and to protect the beauty of life that has been hard-won.

400307.Name: Lost Scroll
400307.Description: Relive The Glory! Legendary Apparel Out For All To See!
400307.LongDescription: ...When the time comes, apparel from the Rayne Family will be put on display at the banquet. He wore this attire when attending the very first banquet to celebrate the victory of the First Hypogean War. It testifies the achievements and contributions of the family's fight against Hypogeans, and is a symbol of the eternal glory of humanity over the Hypogeans. It conveys Kheiss Rayne's will, and inspires us all to move bravely forward into the new era.

400308.Name: Lost Scroll
400308.LongDescription: Breaking news! The Rayne Family's precious apparel has been stolen during the banquet! It is reported that the thief took advantage of lax security to steal the apparel, and the guards involved have been severely disciplined. The last person to touch the apparel, the maid Rosaline, has been taken into custody. However, the whereabouts of the apparel remains unknown. The Lord of the City, Prince Lester, has issued a public notice offering a handsome reward for information on its whereabouts.

703001.Description:
New criminals came in today. Kept saying they were innocent. Well, aren't they all?
First they claim their innocence, then in a few days they'll start yelling and cursing. Haha, they'll be confessing in no time after their spirit is all but broken.
No one who gets thrown into the Black Prison is innocent. Criminals who intend to overthrow the king all meet the same end, where they cry endlessly for mercy.

703002.Name: Warden's Journal: 2
703002.Description:
One of my colleagues has been imprisoned. I never expected there was a rebel next to me. It's amazing how he hides his true identity so well all this time, never giving away even a hint. Occasionally, we would chat as well.
He argued that he had been framed, and I was nearly convinced by his passionate resistance. Evidence may yet to be found, but it is only a matter of time before he confesses anyway.
There is never a wronged soul in the Black Prison.

703003.Name: Warden's Journal: 3
703003.Description:
Damn it! The people in this prison are out of their minds. To accuse me of colluding with the rebels? That's ridiculous! Just because I once spoke with that colleague who has been captured?
This is a false accusation, clear as daylight! No wonder new rebels are being captured every day. They can't show any evidence that I'm guilty, but... no evidence is needed in the Black Prison.
There is never a wronged soul in the Black Prison, because no one has ever walked out of here.

703004.Name: Prisoner's Diary: 1
703004.Description:
Thoran has gone mad. Some people are still being naive and unrealistic, believing that he will become the wise and benevolent king he once was again after strengthening his rule.
The moment he returned to Bantus with the Graveborn army and transformed the people into the undead, I knew without a doubt that the former king had been completely corrupted.
See, the Black Prison is becoming more crowded by the day, and it'll only get worse.

703005.Name: Prisoner's Diary: 2
703005.Description:
Many comrades have been thrown into the Black Prison with me. But most of them have been broken under ceaseless torture, physically and mentally. When we were first imprisoned, we vowed to escape from this dreadful dungeon together.
I'm keeping myself sane, but I don't expect to be pardoned one day.
As long as I am sane, I will be able to escape from the Black Prison one day. That's my promise to my comrades.

703006.Name: Prisoner's Diary: 3
703006.Description:
I have to say, the wardens of the Black Prison are experts at the torture game. I thought I was unbreakable, but now I'm not so sure anymore.
I miss the time when I was a human and able to feel pain in the flesh. At least then I could have been comatose.
I don't know how much longer I can hold up. If I too fall and succumb one day––comrades, please free me from my agony.

4006011.Description: Local to the Hermit Island, soul snatcher is commonly used as a spice. When dried in the sun, they emit a chilling and peculiar aroma. Improper handling when preparing a meal can lead to hallucinations.
4006011.LongDescription: Local to the Hermit Island, soul snatcher is commonly used as a spice. When dried in the sun, they emit a chilling and peculiar aroma. Improper handling when preparing a meal can lead to hallucinations.

4006012.Name: Short-tail Veal Steak
4006012.Description: Short-tail bovines are said to roam around the Steelthorn Cliffs, which they can climb up to make a hasty escape whenever they feel threatened.
4006012.LongDescription: Short-tail bovines are said to roam around the Steelthorn Cliffs, which they can climb up to make a hasty escape whenever they feel threatened.

4006013.Name: Steelthorn Hen
4006013.Description: Native to the Steelthorn Cliffs, the hen is fatty, juicy, and perfect for roasting.
4006013.LongDescription: Native to the Steelthorn Cliffs, the hen is fatty, juicy, and perfect for roasting.

4006014.Name: Chieftain's Peak Bok-choy
4006014.Description: Only Bok-choys that thrive on Chieftain's Peak can withstand hours of boiling.
4006014.LongDescription: Only Bok-choys that thrive on Chieftain's Peak can withstand hours of boiling.

4006015.Name: Oval Citrus
4006015.Description: A magically enhanced fruit with an exquisite aroma. They are quite precious as they are challenging to grow.
4006015.LongDescription: A magically enhanced fruit with an exquisite aroma. They are quite precious as they are challenging to grow.

4006016.Name: Lanternberry Jam
4006016.Description: A rare sweet jam with an enchanting glow. Sampling it directly would color your tongue in fluorescent blue.
4006016.LongDescription: A rare sweet jam with an enchanting glow. Sampling it directly would color your tongue in fluorescent blue.

4006017.Name: Golden Apple
4006017.Description: Fruit of the oasis. Very sweet and juicy with a crunchy texture. Often made into jam.
4006017.LongDescription: Fruit of the oasis. Very sweet and juicy with a crunchy texture. Often made into jam.

4006018.Name: Twin Persimmons
4006018.Description: Wilders cultivated edible fruits and vegetables into one plant that produces two different persimmon varieties; one red and one yellow. The red possesses a robust sweet flavor and the yellow a slightly sour flavor.
4006018.LongDescription: Wilders cultivated edible fruits and vegetables into one plant that produces two different persimmon varieties; one red and one yellow. The red possesses a robust sweet flavor and the yellow a slightly sour flavor.

4006019.Name: Succulent Dewdrop
4006019.Description: A vined plant that possesses a fragrant, mouth-watering aroma, it has a multitude of uses as an ingredient.
4006019.LongDescription: A vined plant that possesses a fragrant, mouth-watering aroma, it has a multitude of uses as an ingredient.

4006020.Name: Rock Orchid
4006020.Description: A prehistoric plant that grows on craggy rock faces, it only bursts through the rock's exterior under warm conditions. Its flowers, which are extremely rare, have luscious petals that can be squeezed into juice.
4006020.LongDescription: A prehistoric plant that grows on craggy rock faces, it only bursts through the rock's exterior under warm conditions. Its flowers, which are extremely rare, have luscious petals that can be squeezed into juice.

4006021.Name: Polar Snowmelt
4006021.Description: During the very first snowfall of the year, snow crystals fall on polar glaciers and are collected and stored in a special bottle. The snow melts into a premium snowdew.
4006021.LongDescription: During the very first snowfall of the year, snow crystals fall on polar glaciers and are collected and stored in a special bottle. The snow melts into a premium snowdew.

509001.Name: Herbicide
509001.Description: For removing thorns in the forest. An essential tool for the villagers.
509001.LongDescription: For removing thorns in the forest. An essential tool for the villagers.

513001.Name: Crude Doll
513001.Description: A crude doll pieced together from easily available materials. At a glance it seems to be Athalia, and despite its roughness was made with some care.
513001.LongDescription: A crude doll pieced together from easily available materials. At a glance it seems to be Athalia, and despite its roughness was made with some care.

514001.Name: Red Plum
514001.Description: Red, aromatic plums are the bears' favorite.
514001.LongDescription: Red, aromatic plums are the bears' favorite.

514002.Name: Yellow Plum
514002.Description: Yellow, aromatic plums are the bears' favorite.
514002.LongDescription: Yellow, aromatic plums are the bears' favorite.

306001.Name: Obsidian Finch Feather Quill
306001.Description: An extremely rare quill made of Obsidian Finch feathers. It possesses mysterious magical powers and can be used for drawing magic circles and casting magic spells.
306001.LongDescription: An extremely rare quill made of Obsidian Finch feathers. It possesses mysterious magical powers and can be used for drawing magic circles and casting magic spells.

306002.Name: Goldflare
306002.Description: It might look just like a common flower, but people say that it can be made into a surprisingly effective medicine that is highly valued.
306002.LongDescription: It might look just like a common flower, but people say that it can be made into a surprisingly effective medicine that is highly valued.

306003.Name: Key
306003.Description: A weird-shaped key. It must be used for opening a very well-guarded door.
306003.LongDescription: A weird-shaped key. It must be used for opening a very well-guarded door.

306004.Name: Bloodberry
306004.Description: A super juicy and magical fruit. Its juice can be used for creating magic circles.
306004.LongDescription: A super juicy and magical fruit. Its juice can be used for creating magic circles.

306005.Name: Lina's Notes
306005.Description: The teleportation spell can send you through the mountains and over the seas. Different spells send you to different locations. You need an Obsidian Finch feather quill dipped in Bloodberry juice to draw the magic circle. The circle must be in the shape of a shield.
306005.LongDescription: The teleportation spell can send you through the mountains and over the seas. Different spells send you to different locations. You need an Obsidian Finch feather quill dipped in Bloodberry juice to draw the magic circle. The circle must be in the shape of a shield.

306006.Name: Child's Old Pillowcase
306006.Description: A simple pillowcase. It looks decades old. There is embroidery in the corner: Lotti - Blue Butterfly Orphanage
306006.LongDescription: A simple pillowcase. It looks decades old. There is embroidery in the corner: Lotti - Blue Butterfly Orphanage

306007.Name: Folded Letterhead
306007.Description: I'm sorry George, but I can't go with you... Mother needs me... I will pretend that I don't know anything if you want.
306007.LongDescription: I'm sorry George, but I can't go with you... Mother needs me... I will pretend that I don't know anything if you want.

306008.Name: Torn Diary
306008.Description: Mother was once a spirited adventurer, but her body now falters under the weight... She yearns for a new body... Perhaps it's time to bid my farewells...
306008.LongDescription: Mother was once a spirited adventurer, but her body now falters under the weight... She yearns for a new body... Perhaps it's time to bid my farewells...

306009.Name: Half a Letter
306009.Description: Alchemical analysis revealed that this is a previously unknown parasitic egg. We were unable to uncover more because the egg was already dead. If you send us more samples, we will be able to learn more. We are very interested in this new specimen and are looking forward to working with you again.
306009.LongDescription: Alchemical analysis revealed that this is a previously unknown parasitic egg. We were unable to uncover more because the egg was already dead. If you send us more samples, we will be able to learn more. We are very interested in this new specimen and are looking forward to working with you again.

306010.Name: Half a Contract
306010.Description: Every year, Baron Salino provides the Wetlov Mercenary Group with enough medicinal goldflare powder for 100 people, and in exchange, the mercenaries give the Goldflare Manor 10,000 pieces of silver.
306010.LongDescription: Every year, Baron Salino provides the Wetlov Mercenary Group with enough medicinal goldflare powder for 100 people, and in exchange, the mercenaries give the Goldflare Manor 10,000 pieces of silver.

306011.Name: Medical Record
306011.Description:
The patient is making a speedy recovery. — Dr. Mary Poole
You're all liars! LIARS!!! I'm a doctor also! This isn't medicine! It's POISON! I feel my mind being swallowed up. HELP ME!!! (Fragmented Handwriting)
306011.LongDescription:
The patient is making a speedy recovery. — Dr. Mary Poole
You're all liars! LIARS!!! I'm a doctor also! This isn't medicine! It's POISON! I feel my mind being swallowed up. HELP ME!!! (Fragmented Handwriting)

603001.Name: Account Book
603001.Description: Lord Beckett's account book contains many secrets. The interesting thing though, is that the writing in the book is very similar to the writing in the letter Robin Hood received.
603001.LongDescription: Lord Beckett's account book contains many secrets. The interesting thing though, is that the writing in the book is very similar to the writing in the letter Robin Hood received.

287001.Name: Base: Melted Frost
287001.Description: Clear water melted from frigid ice which is sweet and refreshing, while preserving the fruit's natural flavors.
287001.LongDescription: Clear water melted from frigid ice which is sweet and refreshing, while preserving the fruit's natural flavors.

287002.Name: Base: Lily Dew
287002.Description: In the morning, dewdrops condense on lily petals, carrying the fragrance of the lilies and adding complexity to drinks.
287002.LongDescription: In the morning, dewdrops condense on lily petals, carrying the fragrance of the lilies and adding complexity to drinks.

287003.Name: Fruit: Red Raspberry
287003.Description: A common fruit with a smooth and refreshing sweetness. Great for making juice.
287003.LongDescription: A common fruit with a smooth and refreshing sweetness. Great for making juice.

287004.Name: Fruit: Golden Apple
287004.Description: A common fruit, yielding abundant juice with a crisp and honey-sweet flavor. Great for making juice.
287004.LongDescription: A common fruit, yielding abundant juice with a crisp and honey-sweet flavor. Great for making juice.

287005.Name: Fruit: Sage Blueberry
287005.Description: A common fruit, sweet and sour, with a soft and tender texture. Best enjoyed or processed shortly after picking. Great for making juice.
287005.LongDescription: A common fruit, sweet and sour, with a soft and tender texture. Best enjoyed or processed shortly after picking. Great for making juice.

287006.Name: Flavoring: Nyamnyam Honey
287006.Description: Thick, premium-quality bee honey – crystal clear with a rich flavor.
287006.LongDescription: Thick, premium-quality bee honey – crystal clear with a rich flavor.

287007.Name: Flavoring: Glowing Fungi Powder
287007.Description: The powdered spores from Glowing Fungi have a unique aroma, infusing drinks with distinctive layers of flavor.
287007.LongDescription: The powdered spores from Glowing Fungi have a unique aroma, infusing drinks with distinctive layers of flavor.

287008.Name: Disgusting Drink
287008.Description: The ingredients are great, but why does the juice taste so weird after making it?
287008.LongDescription: The ingredients are great, but why does the juice taste so weird after making it?

287009.Name: Juice: Raspberry Brew
287009.Description: A juice bursting with the rich flavor of raspberries, sweet and aromatic.
287009.LongDescription: A juice bursting with the rich flavor of raspberries, sweet and aromatic.

287010.Name: Juice: Golden Apple Brew
287010.Description: A juice filled with the tantalizingly sweet flavor of Golden Apple.
287010.LongDescription: A juice filled with the tantalizingly sweet flavor of Golden Apple.

287011.Name: Juice: Blueberry Brew
287011.Description: A juice boasting a rich blueberry flavor, with a perfect balance of sweet and sour.
287011.LongDescription: A juice boasting a rich blueberry flavor, with a perfect balance of sweet and sour.

287012.Name: Juice: Blueberry Mix
287012.Description: Crafted from Melted Frost, Sage Blueberry, and Nyamnyam Honey, this juice is refreshingly sweet and sour. Plus, it's Shemira's favorite drink!
287012.LongDescription: Crafted from Melted Frost, Sage Blueberry, and Nyamnyam Honey, this juice is refreshingly sweet and sour. Plus, it's Shemira's favorite drink!

287013.Name: Recipe
287013.Description:
An old recipe — who knows what tasty concoctions it might yield!
"1 bottle of cowlpie milk, 2 eggs, 1 bag of blueberries, 2 sugar cubes..."
287013.LongDescription:
An old recipe — who knows what tasty concoctions it might yield!
"1 bottle of cowlpie milk, 2 eggs, 1 bag of blueberries, 2 sugar cubes..."

604001.Name: Death Symphony
604001.Description: Allied heroes will have their souls reaped by the God of Death within 2.5 seconds of their health falling below 25%. This skill ignores damage immunity effects.
604001.LongDescription: Allied heroes will have their souls reaped by the God of Death within 2.5 seconds of their health falling below 25%. This skill ignores damage immunity effects.

604002.Name: Lingering Melody
604002.Description: Reduces allied heroes' Health Regeneration Effects during battles by 50%.
604002.LongDescription: Reduces allied heroes' Health Regeneration Effects during battles by 50%.

604003.Name: Despairing Groove
604003.Description: Allied frontline heroes are banished for 5 seconds at the start of battles, during which time they cannot attack or be attacked.
604003.LongDescription: Allied frontline heroes are banished for 5 seconds at the start of battles, during which time they cannot attack or be attacked.

604004.Name: Awkward Harmony
604004.Description: The amount of damage enemy heroes receive from all sources other than ultimate skills is reduced by 30%. The amount of damage enemies receive from ultimate skills is increased by 30%.
604004.LongDescription: The amount of damage enemy heroes receive from all sources other than ultimate skills is reduced by 30%. The amount of damage enemies receive from ultimate skills is increased by 30%.

604005.Name: Slowing Tempo
604005.Description: Allied heroes lose 30 Haste points, but Energy Recovery is increased by 20%.
604005.LongDescription: Allied heroes lose 30 Haste points, but Energy Recovery is increased by 20%.

604006.Name: Fatal Fortissimo
604006.Description: Enemy heroes receive 70% less damage. After 15 seconds of battle enemy heroes lose 15% of their max health per second, but will not die as a result.
604006.LongDescription: Enemy heroes receive 70% less damage. After 15 seconds of battle enemy heroes lose 15% of their max health per second, but will not die as a result.

604007.Name: Delayed Dissonance
604007.Description: Allied heroes lose 3% of their max health every second during battle.
604007.LongDescription: Allied heroes lose 3% of their max health every second during battle.

604008.Name: Impeded Interference
604008.Description: After 10 seconds of battle, allied heroes are stunned for 5 seconds and dealt damage equal to 30% of their max health respectively.
604008.LongDescription: After 10 seconds of battle, allied heroes are stunned for 5 seconds and dealt damage equal to 30% of their max health respectively.

604009.Name: Fading Score
604009.Description: Damage dealt to enemy heroes that is lower than 15% of their max health is reduced by 50%.
604009.LongDescription: Damage dealt to enemy heroes that is lower than 15% of their max health is reduced by 50%.

4011002.Name: Heavy Treasure Chest
4011002.Description: A massive treasure chest packed with all sorts of valuables. It's incredibly heavy!
4011002.LongDescription: A massive treasure chest packed with all sorts of valuables. It's incredibly heavy!

4011005.Name: Song 1: Echoes of Divine Light
4011005.LongDescription:
A grand and solemn melody composed of two instruments.
A sweeping instrumental runs throughout the piece,
concluding with a decisive note that ends the movement.

4011006.Name: Song 2: Dawn in the Wilds
4011006.Description: Composed by a musician from the Wilders, this piece depicts the vibrant life of the Dark Forest.
4011006.LongDescription:
A graceful and flowing melody composed of three instruments:
A gentle wind instrument symbolizes the stream, a refined string instrument capturing the glimmering light in the forest,
and a second string instrument performing a duet to depict the vibrant life of the Wilders.

4011007.Name: Song 3: Volcanic Crescendo
4011007.Description: A mysterious score, created by an unknown composer who was rumored to have been influenced by the Hypogeans. After completing the composition, he disappeared.
4011007.LongDescription:
A solemn and threatening melody composed of four instruments:
Percussion mimicking the vibrations inside a volcano,
a classical six-stringed instrument setting a tense atmosphere,
a rich-toned classical instrument depicting the shock and terror of a volcanic eruption,
and a voice-like instrument that echoes the whispers of the Hypogeans.

4011008.Name: Secret Ingredient
4011008.Description: Hand this over to the innkeeper to obtain the music sheet required for the competition.
4011008.LongDescription: Hand this over to the innkeeper to obtain the music sheet required for the competition.

524001.Name: Lightbearer Rune Stone
524001.Description: Allows you to deploy Lightbearer heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.
524001.LongDescription: Allows you to deploy Lightbearer heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.

524002.Name: Wilder Rune Stone
524002.Description: Allows you to deploy Wilder heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.
524002.LongDescription: Allows you to deploy Wilder heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.

524003.Name: Graveborn Rune Stone
524003.Description: Allows you to deploy Graveborn heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.
524003.LongDescription: Allows you to deploy Graveborn heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.

524004.Name: Mauler Rune Stone
524004.Description: Allows you to deploy Mauler heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.
524004.LongDescription: Allows you to deploy Mauler heroes in dungeon battles, granting them +100% Attack Rating and health.

524005.Name: Frost Lotus
524005.Description: A rare plant that grows near venom spiders, it's said to neutralize their venom. In the nick of time, it just might save your life.
524005.LongDescription: A rare plant that grows near venom spiders, it's said to neutralize their venom. In the nick of time, it just might save your life.
